entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A Gothic horror plane where humanity is outnumbered by vampires, werewolves, ghouls and geists, and the faith that once protected it is fading.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The religion devoted to the archangel Avacyn; each parish has a chapel and priests, though its influence is sometimes strong-armed and resented.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel whose protective faith is losing its potency and who has abandoned humanity.

entities.name: Champion of the Parish
entities.description: A priest or cathar who takes personal responsibility for defending a parish and its people from the night.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Holy warriors and fiend-slayers found in most Innistrad parishes.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: One of Innistrad's four provinces, with a wilderness where humble stone chapels stand at the edge.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The High City, home to fortress-like chapels of the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Humans of Innistrad
entities.description: The protagonists and victims of Innistrad, outnumbered and outgunned by monsters.

events.summary: Some of Innistrad's humans refuse to be victims and become slayers and cathars, and a few take all of humanity as their responsibility as guardians.
events.quote: Some become cathars, holy warriors who train to destroy the fiends that prey upon humanity.

events.summary: The champion emerges in a parish by taking personal responsibility for striking a blow for humanity, sanctioned only by the support of a desperate people.
events.quote: It is a position given sanction by the support of a desperate people in a time of need.

events.summary: Avacyn's faith, humanity's former secret weapon, loses potency night after night as monsters hold every advantage.
events.quote: The monsters have all the advantages and humanity's former secret weapon—the power of faith in the archangel Avacyn—is losing its potency night after night.

events.summary: Avacyn has abandoned humanity, yet champions still resolve to stand between the lurking dangers and their fellow humans.
events.quote: But they know they must try, and that gives them a kind of heroism no matter how the story ends.

relations.note: Each parish chapel is devoted to the Church of Avacyn.
relations.quote: each parish has its own chapel devoted to the Church of Avacyn

relations.note: The champion is a priest or cathar of the parish.
relations.quote: The champion is a priest or cathar who has seen enough suffering in his or her community
Each of Innistrad's four provinces is divided into several counties called parishes
